name: Nanya New Material Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Nanya New Material Technology Co.,Ltd engages in the design, research and development, production, and sales of composite materials in China and internationally. The company offers FR-4, FR-15, automotive, HSD, and RF materials. Its products are used for communication equipment, smartphone, new energy, industrial control, medical devices, high-end servers, new energy vehicles, IC substrate, aerospace, and smart home. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
